description: Header file defining classes and functions for a shader compiler component within the ANGLE project, including the TCompiler class and related utilities.

classes.name: TShHandleBase
classes.description: Base class for handle objects used by the shader compiler, managing memory allocation.

classes.name: TCompiler
classes.description: Main class representing the shader compiler, managing compilation process, resources, and AST analysis.

methods.name: TCompiler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the compiler with shader type, specification, and output format.

methods.name: ~TCompiler
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up compiler resources.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the compiler with built-in resources.

methods.name: compileTreeForTesting
methods.description: Compiles shader code for testing, returning AST or nullptr on errors.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Performs shader compilation from source strings.

methods.name: getShaderVersion
methods.description: Returns the shader version used in compilation.

methods.name: getInfoSink
methods.description: Provides access to the info sink for diagnostics.
